status: first pass (roadmap P9, docs/command/07_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md; docs/campaign/05_THE_SYSTEMS.md section 11)
notes: The battery's combat report compiled from its records and the regiment's check of them (simcore/campaign/report.hpp): how far apart in time two raids are, how a record's entry is matched to the report the radar company said, the marks for the agreement, and the regiment's belief in a unit before its first check.
source: game values; the check itself, a written record set against another, follows bguir_tsp (Dedyaev, BGUIR 2010), who checks an operator's record against a live plot (docs/research/PLOTTING_BOARD_2026-10.md); the marks are the Soviet five-point scale

raid_gap_s.source: game value: targets first written more than ten minutes after the last line of a raid are another raid

match_s.source: game value: a journal line's time column is the time the report was heard; within this of the report said it is that report's line

board_s.source: game value: a mark is drawn when the plotter writes what he heard, or later from the journal's page; up to a reporting period and a half (aspd_u.json air_net_period_s 60) after the report

grade_5.source: game value: the share of the record's entries as said for 'excellent'

trust_prior_checked.source: game value: the regiment's belief in a unit not yet checked counts as this many entries checked

trust_prior_agreed.source: game value: of which this many agreed (a unit is believed at 0.8 before its first check)
